alerts: replication_scored.jsonl, variant S4, primary=true (266 alerts, 197 events)
stop_rule: If no declared test of the input statistics is significant under both Bonferroni and BH, the signal is not statistically valid: verdict NO_DEMONSTRATED_EDGE, the replay below is run once as a descriptive record and nothing is tuned.

verdict_rule.NET_EDGE_SUPPORTED: signal statistically valid AND verified executions (real order-book or real fills) with net PnL > 0 in TEST, event-clustered 95% CI excluding 0, and incremental net PnL over the price-only control CI excluding 0
verdict_rule.UNVERIFIABLE: signal statistically valid but execution cannot be verified (no historical order book and no prospective paper record yet)
verdict_rule.NO_DEMONSTRATED_EDGE: signal not statistically valid (stop rule), OR verified/hypothetical net PnL not positive

triggers.causal_first_candidate: PRIMARY. Earliest S4 candidate of the (market, side) produced by the frozen evaluate_market before its 6-hour largest-total suppression; computable in real time.
triggers.frozen_alert_time: SECONDARY. The frozen primary alert time t; may depend on candidates up to 6 h later (non-maximum suppression keeps the largest), so it is not causal.

latency_justification: Alert time t is the end of a 900-s grid bucket; fills <= t must be indexed by the data-api before the rule can be computed. Indexing lag was not measured in this repository (stated assumption). 60 s = automated pipeline, 300 s = conservative automated or fast human, 900 s = next grid evaluation.
fill_model: Historical order book NOT archived. Ask-side evidence = maker legs of transactions whose taker is identified (a unique row whose size equals the sum of the other rows, >= 3 rows); a maker SELL of token s at p is an ask at p, a maker BUY of the complement at p' is an ask at 1-p'. Transactions with 2 rows are ambiguous and never used (counted). Starting at trigger+latency, levels are consumed in time order (ascending price inside a transaction) until the size is filled or the window ends. Unfilled remainder = not executed (no substitution, no midpoint, no pre-signal price). Status HYPOTHETICAL: our order would have competed for the same liquidity.
fee_formula: fee per share = fee_rate * p * (1 - p) on entry only (hold to resolution, redemption free), same scenarios as edge_research/analysis_plan.md (16/11); historical per-market rates NOT verified. Gas paid by the Polymarket relayer for proxy wallets: 0.
price_only_control: Per alert, K=5 times drawn (seed 20261117 + alert index) from the 900-s grid of the same market and side, at least 1 h after the first fill, at least 6 h from the trigger, before close - latency - window, where the last executed price of side s is within +-0.05 of the alert price. Executed with the same fill model, latency, size and costs.
